deities: Lord Hanuman (Anjaneya, village deity of Shamanur/Shabanur, ~6 ft idol)
festivals: Rathotsava (3-day car festival starting the 10th day after Maha Shivaratri)

history.dynasty: Vijayanagara period (idol installed by Vyasaraya / Vyasatirtha, 15th century per one source); present structure inaugurated 11 March 2000
history.period: Origins ~800 years per local tradition; installation attributed to Vyasaraja (15th century); renovated 2000
history.summary: The flagship Hanuman temple of the Davangere region, at Shamanur (Shabanur) village, counted among the 732 Anjaneya temples attributed to the Dvaita saint Vyasaraja (Vyasatirtha). The ~6-ft Hanuman idol is the village deity. The old shrine was replaced in 2000 by a new east-facing Dravidian-style temple with a five-tier rajagopura bearing a massive stucco Hanuman image, funded by villagers and devotees and inaugurated on 11 March 2000 by Dr. Shivamurthy Shivacharya Mahaswamiji of Taralabalu Jagadguru Brihanmath, Sirigere. Saturdays draw heavy crowds.

name: Sri Anjaneya Swamy Temple
town_description: CSV town 'Davangere' corrected: the temple is at Shamanur (Shabanur) village in Davangere taluk/district, about 4-5 km from Davangere city on the Davangere-Harihar bypass road. The temple is the village's main landmark and serves as Davangere's principal Hanuman shrine, drawing large crowds especially on Saturdays.

travel.road: On the Davangere-Harihar bypass; ~5 km by local bus from Davangere bus stand

visitor_information.best_time: Rathotsava season (after Maha Shivaratri); October to March
